entities.name: Theodore Gabras
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theodore Gabras was a Byzantine governor in the Pontus who was involved in a minor unsuccessful rebellion against the Emperor Alexios I Komnenos around the year 1091. He is an Eastern Orthodox martyr whose feast day is celebrated on 2 October.
